metadata.title: Services
metadata.description: Explore verified legal, CA, property, GST, documentation and government-service categories.

hero.title: Professional categories built around trust and paperwork.
hero.copy: Bharosa Hai focuses on service categories where experience, credentials and correct documents matter from the first conversation.

overview.title: Every category is designed for clear customer decisions.
overview.copy: The platform explains problems, available help, expected benefits and the process instead of showing generic listings.

categories.title: Legal Services

faq.title: Practical questions about the service model.

items.question: Are services bookable today?
items.answer: The customer booking flow is being prepared for verified providers. Current focus is onboarding and verifying providers.

items.question: Why are categories limited?
items.answer: The MVP intentionally focuses on high-trust categories before expanding into broader services.

items.question: Will providers be verified?
items.answer: Yes. Provider verification is part of the core onboarding model before future customer visibility.

items.question: Can I suggest a service category?
items.answer: Yes. Use the contact page to suggest a category or city for future expansion.
